# Arsany Milad

> Senior fullstack engineer in Alexandria, Egypt, with about 4 years in software. I build products end to end, from the database to the demo: TypeScript, Node.js and NestJS, React and React Native, PostgreSQL, Retool, Databricks and AWS. At Stackdrop I am embedded with Wayve as Retool engineer and product owner for the Fleet Systems & Insights tools, used across the UK, US, Germany and Japan: I lead discovery, requirements and demos, and build the tools myself, in weeks. I also founded Dentica, an Arabic-first dental practice management platform now in closed beta.

- Location: Alexandria, Egypt
- Role: Senior Fullstack Engineer
- Education: Bachelor of Computer Science, Faculty of Computers and Data Science, Alexandria University (2019 to 2023)
- Skills: TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, React, React Native, Expo, Angular, Python (FastAPI), Retool, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Supabase, MySQL, Databricks, Lakebase, Kafka, AWS, Azure, Docker, GitHub Actions, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Claude Code, RAG pipelines, Discovery and requirements, Product ownership
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/arsany-milad
- GitHub: https://github.com/arsanylabs

## Experience

- Senior Software Engineer, Stackdrop (Apr 2024 – present): Remote-first software house headquartered in Athens. I work as a contractor across several client projects at once. The headline engagement is Wayve, where I am embedded with Fleet Operations as Retool engineer and product owner for the Fleet Systems & Insights portfolio, used across the UK, US, Germany and Japan. Primary engineer on 5+ production apps, on a Retool platform used by 70+ people. Alongside it, I build Hub Rural's compliance and CRM platform.
- Software Engineer, Spare (Sep 2022 – Mar 2024): Spare, Schools Made Smarter. My first job, before Stackdrop: building features end to end, from the MySQL schema through the Node.js APIs to the Angular front end.

## Projects

- Dentica: Dental practice management for Egypt, for solo doctors and clinics, on web and mobile. Arabic-first, with a dental chart drawn as real teeth. I founded it and built it, and it is now in closed beta.
- Viorette: Sterling silver jewelry for women in Egypt and the MENA region. A year-long side hustle with my cofounder: we did everything together, from the store and the designs to marketing and shipping, and grew it to 300 orders a month at break-even before I exited.
- Retool Bridge: Open source. Runs Retool Apps-as-Code React apps on your own machine, driven over MCP, with each session isolated in its own git worktree and read-only by default.
- Marathon Navigator: A live mobile app for a charity's multi-team youth competitions: a live leaderboard, role-restricted score entry, QR attendance that works offline, and tournaments. In English and Arabic with full right-to-left support.
- Karouz: In progress. I am working with about 20 managing admins of a charity program to turn how they run it into requirements and a design direction, ahead of launching a testing platform for hundreds of children.
- Knowledge Hub: A self-hosted RAG knowledge assistant. Upload your own documents and ask them questions in plain language, answered by a local DeepSeek model. Nothing leaves the machine, so it works fully offline.
